title: 7-day motor imagery BCI EEG dataset from Zhou et al 2021
description: A longitudinal EEG dataset of motor imagery brain-computer interface (BCI) recordings from 20 healthy participants, each recorded over 7 sessions on separate days. Participants performed cued imagery of left hand, right hand, both feet, and rest without feedback, for 33,600 trials in total. Data were recorded at 500 Hz with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier using 41-electrode or 26-electrode caps, plus EOG channels; the M1/M2 mastoid channels are included as MISC channels for the 41-electrode cap. The data are preprocessed. The BIDS version was regenerated through MOABB with corrected channel names and electrode positions.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier (Ag/AgCl electrodes, Cz reference, AFz ground, 0.5-100 Hz bandpass, 50 Hz notch). Each of 7 daily sessions contained 6 runs of 40 trials. Visual arrow cues prompted 5 s motor imagery of left hand, right hand, feet, or rest, with no feedback.
